info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Supplier Agreements Management API
info.description: The Supplier Agreements Management API facilitates the creation and management of supplier agreements within the banking environment. This endpoint allows users to submit new agreements, ensuring all necessary details are captured efficiently. Use cases typically involve procurement teams and financial departments looking to streamline supplier onboarding processes and compliance management. By leveraging this API, businesses can maintain up-to-date agreements and improve supplier relationship management.

post.description: This operation allows the user to create a new supplier agreement for an external agency, facilitating the management of supplier relationships and contract details.

requestBody.description: This request body contains the details necessary for creating or updating supplier agreements with external agencies. The information provided will define the terms of the agreement and the parties involved.
